title: RaskSignatureRunFacet
description: An Ed25519 signature over an OpenLineage event, made by the identity that produced it. It rides the run facets of a RunEvent and the dataset facets of a DatasetEvent. The signed bytes are canon-1 of the whole event with exactly one member removed, <facets>.rask_signature.signature; canon-1 is the binary64 (I-JSON) profile of json.dumps(sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False) over the event with every integral float below 2^53 written as an integer. The signer is the event's author, or declares onBehalfOf equal to that author and is a delegator the verifier names.

canon.description: The canonicalization the signed bytes use. A new profile is a new number.

kid.description: Names the signing key: the first 16 hex characters of the sha256 of the raw 32-byte public key. It is derived from the key, so a re-minted key has a new kid and a kid is never shared by two keys.

identity.description: The signing identity, which selects the public keys the verifier reads. It is the signer's own claim: a verifier checks it against the identities it lists before reading any key.

onBehalfOf.description: The subject the signer acts for, declared by a service that authenticated a person and emits on their behalf. It has to equal the author the event stamps, and only a listed delegator may declare it.

signature.description: The 64-byte Ed25519 signature, base64url without padding.
